account.neverSynced: Nothing has been read from Apple Ads yet. Press Sync.
account.partial: The last read was cut short, so some rows may be missing.
account.synced: The last read covered {{campaigns}} campaigns, from {{from}} to {{to}}.
campaigns.empty: No campaign promoting this app has data in this range.
err.credentialKind: Choose an Apple Ads API user key credential.
err.credentialNotFound: That credential does not exist in this workspace.
err.notLinked: This app is not linked to an Apple Ads account. Link it first.
err.notSupported: Apple Ads is for App Store apps. This app is not one.
err.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
link.accountHint: Only accounts the key can read are listed. Loading them asks Apple Ads once.
link.adamHint: The number after id in the App Store address of the app. Kiln uses the store id of the record when you leave it empty.
link.adamInvalid: Use only digits: 5 to 15 of them.
link.askAdmin: Ask an admin to link this app to an Apple Ads account.
link.credentialDeleted: The credential of this link was deleted. Choose another.
link.credentialsHint: Add an Apple Ads API user key under <link>Credentials</link> first. It only needs read access.
link.noAccounts: This key sees no ad account. Invite its API user to the account in Apple Ads.
link.notLinked: This app is not linked to an Apple Ads account.
link.readOnly: Read only: Kiln reads reports and never changes a campaign, a budget or a bid.
link.removed: The link was removed. The stored reports of this app were kept until they age out.
noApple: Apple Ads is for App Store apps. This app has no App Store record.
overview.coverage: Days with data: {{days}}. Campaigns: {{campaigns}}. Amounts in {{currency}}.
overview.empty: No Apple Ads data from {{from}} to {{to}}. Press Sync to read it, or choose another range.
overview.table: Show the days as a table
rail.label: Apple Ads sections
rangeClamped: Apple Ads is read one year at a time: the last year of this range is shown.
settings.description: Which Apple Ads ad account reports on this app. Read only: nothing is changed in Apple Ads.
settings.title: Apple Ads
setup.lead: Link an Apple Ads account to see what your campaigns spent and which search terms led to taps and installs. Kiln only reads reports.
setup.needsCredential: No Apple Ads credential exists yet. Add one under Credentials: the guide there explains the key.
setup.step1: In Apple Ads, create an API user with a read-only role and a key pair, and save the public key.
setup.step2: Add the private key and its ids under Credentials, as an Apple Ads API user key.
setup.step3: Choose the credential and the ad account below, then press Link ad account.
setup.title: Link Apple Ads
terms.empty: No search term in this range. Apple hides terms with very few impressions, so a small campaign may show none.
terms.emptyKeywords: No keyword has data in this range.
terms.hiddenNote: Apple hides search terms with very few impressions, so this is not every search.
warn.capCampaigns: Only the campaigns with the most impressions were read.
warn.currencyMismatch: Some days were left out because they were not in the currency of the ad account.
warn.noCampaign: No campaign promotes this app. Check the Apple id of the app.
warn.popularityFailed: Apple’s own popularity could not be read this time. The rest was read.
warn.popularityPartial: Apple’s own popularity was read for some of your keywords only.
warn.readCut: A read was cut short to stay within limits. Press Sync again later.
warn.unknown: The last read reported something this version does not know.
